# MC# API Reference (generated)

<!-- Generated by `mcs --api-docs > docs/api.md` from src/Mcs.Compiler/Prelude.cs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every built-in type and member, exactly as the compiler declares it: parameter names, default values and
every enum value. Explanations and examples are in the [library reference](libraries.md); the precise rules
are in the [specification](ko/spec.md).

- `Milli` is shown for `float` and `Q16` for `double` (they are the same types).
- `object` parameters take an entity object or an entity reference unless the comment says otherwise.
- `// since X` marks members that need Minecraft X or later; using them on older targets is a compile error.
- Block classes (`Stone`, `OakStairs`, …) and `EntityType` are generated per version from game data and are not listed.

## Core — always available

### Attributes

```csharp
/// Marks a class as an entity class: instances are entities of this type (+ tag).
[Entity(string type, string tag = null)]
/// Per-entity scoreboard field. Default objective: <namespace>.<field_name>
[Score(string objective = null, Display = …, Color = …, Criteria = …)]
/// The method body is inlined at each call site; constant arguments stay compile-time constants.
[Inline]
/// Runs every time the datapack loads (#minecraft:load).
[Load]
/// Runs every tick (#minecraft:tick).
[Tick]
/// A player joins the world (every login, including the first).
[OnJoin]
/// A player joins for the first time (also players online when the pack is first installed).
[OnFirstJoin]
/// A player died (runs at the death position, while the player is on the death screen).
[OnDeath]
/// A player respawned after dying.
[OnRespawn]
/// A player killed something (mob or player). int parameter: number of kills.
[OnKill]
/// A player used an item. Right-click detection works for carrot_on_a_stick and warped_fungus_on_a_stick;
/// other items count when they are actually used (eaten, thrown, placed, …).
[OnRightClick(string item = "carrot_on_a_stick")]
/// A player ran /trigger <objective> (no operator permission needed). int parameter: the value (1 for a plain /trigger).
[OnTrigger(string objective)]
/// A player right-clicked while holding this item object (a static Item field):
/// [OnRightClickObject(nameof(wand))]. The item must be carrot_on_a_stick or warped_fungus_on_a_stick.
[OnRightClickObject(string field)]
/// A statistic of a player went up, e.g. "minecraft.custom:minecraft.jump" or "minecraft.mined:minecraft.stone".
[OnStat(string criterion)]
/// `/` and `%` in this method or class use Minecraft's own scoreboard division: one command, rounds toward
/// −∞, and the remainder takes the divisor's sign (-7 / 2 = -4, -7 % 2 = 1). Faster than C# division.
[MinecraftDivision]
/// `/` and `%` in this method or class use C# division even when the project uses "division": "minecraft".
[CSharpDivision]
/// A function of another datapack: [External("other:path/func")] static extern void F();
/// Parameters become macro arguments ($(name), 1.20.2+); an int/bool result is the function's /return value.
/// Function tags work too: [External("#other:hooks")].
[External(string function)]
/// A static class whose extern methods are methods of another MC# datapack (its namespace, and the class
/// the methods are declared in there, if any). Arguments and results use that pack's scores.
[McsPack(string ns, string className = null)]
```

### NString

```csharp
/// A string that exists at run time, stored in NBT storage. Comparing, Length, Substring work on every
/// version; joining values (+, $"...") and runtime indexes need function macros (1.20.2+).
public sealed class NString
{
    public static implicit operator NString(string s);
    public static NString operator +(NString a, NString b);
    public static NString operator +(NString a, object b);
    public static NString operator +(object a, NString b);
    public static bool operator ==(NString a, NString b);
    public static bool operator !=(NString a, NString b);
    public int Length { get; }
    public bool IsEmpty { get; }
    /// One character (as an NString).
    public NString this[int index] { get; }
    public NString Substring(int start);
    public NString Substring(int start, int length);
    public bool StartsWith(NString prefix);
    public bool EndsWith(NString suffix);
    /// Position of the first occurrence, or -1 (1.20.2+).
    public int IndexOf(NString value);
    public bool Contains(NString value);
    /// Parses the text as an integer (0 if it is not a number; 1.20.2+).
    public int ToInt();
    /// The text of any value: NString.From(score) (1.20.2+ for runtime values).
    public static NString From(object value);
}
```

### NArray

```csharp
/// An array whose length can change at run time, stored in NBT storage. T: int, bool, Milli, Q16, NString.
/// Constant indexes, Add, Length and foreach work on every version; runtime indexes need 1.20.2+ (macros).
public sealed class NArray<T> : IEnumerable<T>
{
    public NArray();
    /// `length` elements with the default value (0 / false / "").
    public NArray(int length);
    public T this[int index] { get; set; }
    public int Length { get; }
    public int Count { get; }
    public void Add(T value);
    public void Insert(int index, T value);
    public void RemoveAt(int index);
    /// Removes the last element and returns it.
    public T Pop();
    public void Clear();
}
```

### Execute

```csharp
/// A fluent /execute: Execute.AsPlayerObject(p).At(p).IfBlock("stone", pos).Run(() => { ... }).
/// Write the whole chain in one statement ending with .Run(...). Targets are an Entity, an entity
/// reference (Player.All, an entity class) or a selector string.
public static class Execute
{
    /// as <target>: runs for each target as @s.
    public static ExecuteChain As(object target);
    /// as <players>: runs for each player as @s.
    public static ExecuteChain AsPlayerObject(PlayerLib.Player players);
    /// at <target>: the position, rotation and dimension of each target.
    public static ExecuteChain At(object target);
    /// The position (and its dimension).
    public static ExecuteChain At(Position pos);
    public static ExecuteChain Positioned(Position pos);
    public static ExecuteChain In(WorldLib.Dimension dimension);
    public static ExecuteChain Facing(Position pos);
    public static ExecuteChain Facing(object target);
    public static ExecuteChain Rotated(Milli yaw, Milli pitch);
    public static ExecuteChain RotatedAs(object target);
    public static ExecuteChain AnchoredEyes();
    /// align <axes> ("xyz", "xz", ...).
    public static ExecuteChain Align(string axes);
    public static ExecuteChain IfBlock(string id, Position pos);
    public static ExecuteChain IfBlockObject(BlockLib.Block block, Position pos);
    public static ExecuteChain UnlessBlock(string id, Position pos);
    public static ExecuteChain UnlessBlockObject(BlockLib.Block block, Position pos);
    /// if entity <target>: continues if the target exists.
    public static ExecuteChain IfEntity(object target);
    public static ExecuteChain UnlessEntity(object target);
    /// Continues if the condition is true (checked at this point of the chain, e.g. once per As target).
    public static ExecuteChain If(bool condition);
    public static ExecuteChain Unless(bool condition);
    /// Raw execute subcommands ("anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^1").
    public static ExecuteChain Sub(string subcommands);
}
```

```csharp
public static class Builtins
```

```csharp
/// NBT data storage. path: an NBT path ("a.b[0]"). storage: a storage id (default "<namespace>:data").

}
```

### Display

```csharp
/// Common part of block, item and text displays (an entity: Kill, Teleport, Glowing … work too).
public abstract class Display : EntityLib.Entity
{
    public Billboard Billboard { get; set; }
    public Milli ViewRange { get; set; }
    public Milli ShadowRadius { get; set; }
    public Milli ShadowStrength { get; set; }
    public Milli Width { get; set; }
    public Milli Height { get; set; }
    public int GlowColor { get; set; }
    /// Light level 0–15 used instead of the light at the entity (block and sky light).
    public int Brightness { get; set; }
    /// Uniform scale (transformation)
    public Milli Scale { get; set; }
    public Milli ScaleX { get; set; }
    public Milli ScaleY { get; set; }
    public Milli ScaleZ { get; set; }
    /// Translation of the model relative to the entity (transformation)
    public Milli OffsetX { get; set; }
    public Milli OffsetY { get; set; }
    public Milli OffsetZ { get; set; }
    /// Rotation of the model in degrees: around the Y axis (counterclockwise seen from above), then around the X axis
    public Milli RotationY { set; }
    public Milli RotationX { set; }
    /// Ticks over which changes to the transformation are animated (see Animate)
    public int InterpolationDuration { get; set; }
    public int InterpolationDelay { get; set; }
    /// Ticks over which teleports are smoothed (1.20.2+)
    public int TeleportDuration { get; set; }   // since 1.20.2
    /// Animate the transformation changes made in this tick over `ticks` ticks.
    public void Animate(int ticks);
}
```

### Region

```csharp
/// A box of blocks between two corners (relative to the same position, or absolute).
/// Clone / Move / Stack copy blocks right away; Copy / Cut give a Clipboard to Paste later.
public sealed class Region
{
    public Region(Position from, Position to);
    public bool Fill(string block);
    public bool Fill(Block block);
    public bool Replace(string from, string to);
    /// Fills the region with air.
    public bool Clear();
    /// Copies the blocks to dest (the new lowest corner). masked: skip air.
    public bool Clone(Position dest, bool masked = false);
    /// Moves the blocks to dest; the region becomes air.
    public bool Move(Position dest);
    /// Copies the region `count` times next to itself in a direction.
    public bool Stack(Direction direction, int count = 1);
    /// Copies the region `count` times, each one (dx, dy, dz) further.
    public bool Stack(int dx, int dy, int dz, int count = 1);
    /// A clipboard that pastes the region as it is when pasted.
    public Clipboard Copy();
    /// A clipboard holding the blocks as they are now (saved into the buffer area, which must be free).
    public Clipboard Copy(Position buffer);
    /// Moves the blocks into the buffer area and returns it as a clipboard (the region becomes air).
    public Clipboard Cut(Position buffer);
    /// Whether the blocks at `other` are the same as in this region (execute if blocks).
    public bool Matches(Position other, bool masked = false);
}
```

## MathLib

Load with `use MathLib;`.

### Math

```csharp
/// Trigonometry on Q15.16 fixed point (quarter-wave lookup table + linear interpolation, no Taylor series).
/// Angles are in radians. The float overloads compute in double precision and round to float.
public static class Math
{
    public const Q16 PI = 3.14159265358979323846;
    public const Q16 Tau = 6.28318530717958647692;
    public const Q16 Deg2Rad = PI / 180;
    public const Q16 Rad2Deg = 180 / PI;
    public static Q16 Sin(Q16 radians);
    public static Milli Sin(Milli radians);
    public static Q16 Cos(Q16 radians);
    public static Milli Cos(Milli radians);
    public static Q16 Tan(Q16 radians);
    public static Milli Tan(Milli radians);
    /// Division rounded down (toward −∞) — a single scoreboard operation, faster than `/`.
    public static int FloorDiv(int a, int b);
    /// Remainder with the sign of the divisor (pairs with FloorDiv) — a single scoreboard operation.
    public static int FloorMod(int a, int b);
}
```

```csharp
    public static bool IsBlockObject(BlockLib.Block block, Position pos);
    /// Gives an item object to players. Consumes the object (see Clone()).
    public static bool GiveObject(ItemLib.Item item, PlayerLib.Player to, int count = 1);
    public static void SetWorldSpawn(Position pos);
    /// Binds a static int/bool field to an existing score: "objective.holder" (split at the last '.').
    /// Compile-time: applies to the whole program wherever it is written (also at the top level).
    public static bool Mount(int variable, string target);
    public static bool Mount(bool variable, string target);
    public static bool Mount(int variable, string objective, string holder);
    public static bool Mount(bool variable, string objective, string holder);
    /// Binds a scoreboard class (class X : dummy) to an objective name.
    public static bool Mount(System.Type scoreboard, string objective);
    /// Binds an Entity (or entity reference) variable to an existing entity: a tag ("boss"), a selector
    /// ("@e[type=minecraft:zombie,limit=1]") or a UUID. Compile-time, like Mount.
    public static bool MountEntity(EntityLib.Entity variable, string target);
    public static bool MountEntity(EntityObject variable, string target);
    /// Binds a block variable to the block at a position: reading its states checks the world, setting them
    /// places the block there.
    public static bool MountBlock(BlockLib.Block variable, Position pos);
    /// Runs a function of any datapack (or a #tag) and returns its result.
    public static int Call(string function);
    public static void Reload();
    /// A raw execute condition, e.g. m.Check("block ~ ~ ~ minecraft:stone") → execute if block ...
    public static bool Check(string condition);
    /// Runs a command and returns its result value (execute store result). Interpolated values become macro arguments.
    public static int Result(string command);
    /// Runs a command and returns whether it succeeded.
    public static bool Success(string command);
    /// Random integer in [min, max] (inclusive).
    public static int Random(int min, int max);
    public static void Schedule(Action function, int ticks);
    public static void ClearSchedule(Action function);
}
```
